text:
elaine (sre): dropping follow-ups from the postmortem here. single-thread to capture owners + minimal next steps. react with :white_check_mark: when you take something.
rafael (eng-runtime): I'll own the resume/handshake audit. I'll map resume token flow across clients + workers and list missing invariants. aim: audit note by 2026-03-26.
marta (eng-platform): I'll own instrumentation + alerts. Plan: add streaming.partial_response_rate, a heatmap for chunk size, and a PD rule for repeated partials. PR by 2026-03-24.
devindra (ml): i'll evaluate model-side stalls; suggest early-flush and soft limits when upstream latency spikes. ETA 2026-03-28.
infra-oncall (infra): will stage a temporary keepalive at 3s for 48h during the initial rollout window. feature-flag ff/streaming/ka-3s created.
ops-bot: INC-20260322 filed. Linked ticket TICKET-3555.
elaine (sre): short pattern: partial responses or silent streams after ~N chunks during node drains or scale-up events. recurrence in last 10 incidents, often 01:45-04:00 UTC.
rafael (eng-runtime): working hypothesis: graceful-drain sequence can orphan in-flight streams if resume tokens aren't checkpointed to a durable store. reproduction steps: simulate node drain + concurrent streams.
marta (eng-platform): instrumentation checklist:
- metric: streaming.partial_response_count (per model, per zone)
- histogram: stream.chunk_duration_ms
- saved query: join partials -> k8s.restart events
- alert: page if partial_response_count > 3 in 5m AND restart_events > 0
I'll attach dashboards and the saved query to TICKET-3555.
elaine (sre): owner timeline matrix:
- resume/handshake audit: rafael -> 2026-03-26
- telemetry & PD rule: marta -> 2026-03-24
- client retry RFC: elaine -> 2026-03-23
- model backpressure guidance: devindra -> 2026-03-28
- integration test harness: rafael+marta -> 2026-03-31
please shout if dates need shifting.
rafael (eng-runtime): dates look OK. splitting runtime work: (1) audit + extra logs by 3/26, (2) durable resume token write + graceful-drain change by 3/31.
marta (eng-platform): opened WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1359 (adds metrics + alert rules). Dash: Streaming / Partial Response Heatmap.
elaine (sre): client RFC draft: https://docs.internal/retries/streaming-resume-rfc.md Key asks: exponential retry with jitter, resume token idempotency, cap immediate retries, and client-side short-circuit on repeated partials.
devindra (ml): modelops note draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/modelops/pull/450 Recs: early token flush at 75% of max_seq for long generations, dynamic max_tokens throttle during high ingress.
infra-oncall (infra): enabling ff/streaming/ka-3s at 03:30 UTC for 48h. monitoring: control-plane cpu, stream connection count, and partials metric. rollback if cpu > 72% or error rate rises.
rafael (eng-runtime): log snippet I'll add to PR to improve triage:
```
stream_id=3f7b stage=resume-check worker=gpu-11 event=node-drain err="resume token missing: checkpoint write failed"
```
elaine (sre): proposal: if partials alert fires twice within 90 minutes, auto-page runtime oncall and create high-priority incident. approve?
devindra (ml): approve.
infra-oncall (infra): approve.
marta (eng-platform): approve; will add PD escalation and link short runbook in alert text.
elaine (sre): automation ask: correlate partial spikes with autoscaler and node events. marta, can you create a saved query and attach to TICKET-3555?
marta (eng-platform): yes — adding saved query and a Grafana panel that overlays k8s restarts with partial rates. TICKET-3555 updated.
rafael (eng-runtime): test plan: unit tests for handshake state machine + staging synthetic run (1k concurrent streams) during node drain. will post results and add stability assertions to CI.
marta (eng-platform): tagging incidents with tag=streaming-partial-2026 for recurrence queries.
elaine (sre): daily 10-min sync in #incidents until critical items are closed. owners — update ticket before sync.
devindra (ml): will coordinate with runtime on graceful backpressure signals.
ops-bot: TICKET-3555 updated with PRs: 1359, 450. Next check-in scheduled 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC.
elaine (sre): thanks all — please react with :white_check_mark: once you land the first PR/RFC. will fold owners into the postmortem and schedule weekly recurrence once stable.
rafael (eng-runtime): :white_check_mark:
marta (eng-platform): :white_check_mark:
devindra (ml): :white_check_mark:
infra-oncall (infra): :white_check_mark:
elaine (sre): thread closed; moving notes to the weekly review channel after remediation is complete.
